categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies GitHub Actions CI scripts (.github/ci-windows-cross.py, .github/ci-windows.py) and carries the Windows label.
categories.rationale: Ensures Qt unit test diagnostics are visible in Windows CI logs by setting QT_ASSUME_STDERR_HAS_CONSOLE=1. Without this, Qt suppresses test output when running without an attached console in GitHub Actions, obscuring test failures.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and fixes the reporting mechanism for Qt unit tests (test_bitcoin-qt.exe) under Windows CI.
categories.rationale: Restores visibility into Qt unit test failures by preventing test report suppression in Windows CI. Without the environment flag, the entire test report is lost if a failure occurs in GHA.
